verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.yapily.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of markdown doc pages. Yapily also has a dedicated AI-agents docs page for connecting Claude, Cursor, or other agents via MCP, llms.txt, or Agent Skills, giving a searchable live connection to the docs. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually being used with these docs, and in-depth detail on the Agent Skills content.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.yapily.com/llms.txt # Yapily API Documentation
Connect Claude, Cursor, or another AI coding agent directly to these docs via MCP, llms.txt, or Agent Skills.
Connecting over MCP gives your agent a live, searchable connection to this documentation.
